name: Moroccan Chickpea Tagine
ingredients: 1 tsp each cumin, coriander powder and paprika
½ tsp cinnamon and ½ tsp turmeric
2 tbsp lemon juice, parsley and coriander
steps: Heat the oil and cook the onion for 5 minutes. Add the garlic and spices and stir for 1 minute.
Add the carrots, tomatoes and stock; cover and simmer for 12 minutes.
Add the zucchini and chickpeas and simmer for 10 minutes uncovered.
Season and finish with lemon juice and fresh herbs.
Serve with a small portion of whole-wheat couscous if desired.
note: No dried fruit or honey is added, which keeps the sugar low.
